raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivered customer_id unpadded (e.g. 'C52', 'C3', 'C143') instead of the 5-digit format 'C00052' used in raw_customers. The inner join in gold_region_daily silently dropped those rows (4558 vs 4234). Re-padding the numeric part in silver_transactions restores the join keys and also corrects gold_customer_spend, which was splitting customers across two ids.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
